title: Grateful Dead Live at Red Rocks Ampitheatre on 1982-07-27
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v1.5 -> Samplitude Professional v10.22 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sennheiser 421 -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell UDXLII-C90/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Hand‑held audience recording captures a wet‑night Red Rocks show with Phil’s booming bass on “Playing in the Band” and “The Other One”, delivered with excellent clarity.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered for a soaked but high‑energy performance, highlighted by Phil Lesh’s massive bass work during the opening of “Playing in the Band” and the later “Other One”.  Jim Wise’s hand‑held (FOB) recording is praised for top‑notch clarity despite a brief crowd‑outro cut, making the average‑good show sound especially vivid.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the set positively (4 stars) and praise the recording quality; a couple of low‑star, experience‑focused reviews lower the average slightly, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hand‑held (FOB) capture by Jim Wise; very close‑in whooping with high fidelity and clarity.  Crowd ambience at the show’s end is cut off, but overall mix is clean despite rain.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid average set that flows well; the first half builds into a spacey, bass‑driven second half with good transitions.

band_member_comments.Phil: Underwater stage but delivered huge bass notes throughout, especially at the start of “Playing in the Band” and during the climax of “The Other One”.
